title: Half-measure Gaussian stability
statement: For every real $\rho$, the Gaussian halfspace stability at measure parameter $1/2$ equals the probability that two independent standard real Gaussians $G,H$ satisfy $G\le0$ and $\rho G+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,H\le0$.
